items.heading: Every table proposed work for the staff and no table proposed removing any
items.subheading: The day produced 29 actions, all adding to the same four people's workload. Before prioritising, the group needs to decide what stops.

items.heading: The two arguments that stayed open are the ones where both sides cite the same evidence
items.subheading: The ground floor and the programme both turn on the compost debate and the café, quoted by each side in its own favour. More evidence will not settle them. They close by a decision about what the place is for.

items.heading: In five hours nobody mentioned the website, the newsletter, or anything on a screen
items.subheading: What members experience as this organisation is physical and face to face. A plan that routes belonging through digital channels starts from outside the room's picture of itself.

items.heading: The groups with the most power over the outcome were not in the room
items.subheading: The board, the funders and the neighbours were each talked about all day and never heard from. Every question the day left open runs through at least one of them.
